children.author: jofzar
children.text:
The key part of ZDR is zero, not sometimes, or "only if their caught"

> There is no way to have an ironclad ZDR promise, as even root inference providers in a direct API contract could be hacked or have retention misconfiguration.

Then they should never offer it and it's crazy they still are, if you can't verify that zdr is actually happening and enforce it yourself then wtf are you doing. Putting "canaries" in when you offer the service doesn't work.

I'm going to be surprised if legally openrouter can survive this.

I think about this in relative privacy terms, not absolute. They say the following:

We are adapting the researchers’ testing approach so we can run these checks on an ongoing basis.

If providers are regularly canary tested by them it is not a perfect guarantee, but it does reduce risk by a lot. There is no way to have an ironclad ZDR promise, as even root inference providers in a direct API contract could be hacked or have retention misconfiguration. But there are many different levels of data risk and OpenRouter should be able to do a lot of risk reducing work. Let’s see what they do with that.

https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/data-processing-inc...

Openrouters response.

Honestly I'm not sure how anyone could ever trust them for ZDR ever again, they don't seem to be doing their due diligence. (See data residency below)

> This wasn’t limited to requests sent to the lab directly. Several U.S. hosting providers resell this lab’s models, and prompts sent to those providers triggered the exact same scraper – the prompts were flowing back to the lab. A customer who picked a U.S. provider specifically to keep their data in the U.S. didn’t get what they paid for.

Edit: Thinking on this more, I don't see how they could have offered ZDR unless the "provider" has more skin in the game then them. The reason you trust Amazon/google with ZDR is because if they break contract/get caught out it will be a massive lawsuit and social/industry backlash.

"Providers" via openrouter don't have that skin in the game, all the reputation is with openrouter and now that the trust chain is broken, I don't see how anyone in good faith could ever use them for their "zdr" or "hosting" location ever again.
